scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:auth && npm run smoke:workflow && npm run smoke:submissions && npm run smoke:models && npm run smoke:core && npm run smoke:live
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:py && npm run test:speech
scripts.test:speech: docker compose run --rm --no-deps media python -m unittest test_speech -v
scripts.typecheck: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web npm run typecheck
scripts.build:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web sh -c "npm ci && npm run build"
scripts.tidy: docker compose run --rm go mod tidy
scripts.check: npm run fmt && npm run vet && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U megamoot -d megamoot
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose exec postgres psql -U megamoot -d megamoot -c "SELECT version, applied_at FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version"
